verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official MCP server and CLI that agents use to read and change collections, environments and teams, so issuing scoped credentials for those agents is a fair question. However, no evidence documents personal access tokens, scoped API keys, or per-agent permission limits. OAuth 2.0 grant types, secret variables and client certificates authenticate outgoing requests to other APIs; they are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.
